The '''12th Golden Laurel Awards''' (also known as '''2001 Golden Laurel Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2000, were held at [[The Century Plaza Hotel]] in [[Los Angeles, California]] on March 3, 2001. The nominees were announced on January 10, 2001.<ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=PGA Golden Laurel noms come of age|url=https://variety.com/2001/film/awards/pga-golden-laurel-noms-come-of-age-1117791612/|accessdate=September 22, 2017|work=Variety|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170922195007/http://variety.com/2001/film/awards/pga-golden-laurel-noms-come-of-age-1117791612/|archivedate=September 22, 2017|date=January 10, 2001|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=12th Annual Golden Laurel Awards are announced |url=http://www.producersguild.com/special_bulletin/goldenlaurel.html |publisher=Producers Guild of America |accessdate=April 16, 2020 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20010211184946/http://www.producersguild.com/special_bulletin/goldenlaurel.html |archivedate=February 11, 2001 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Producers Guild of America Announces Winners of the 2001 Golden Laurel Awards |url=http://www.producersguild.org/pg/awards_a/awards2001win.asp |publisher=Producers Guild of America |accessdate=April 16, 2020 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20030215170456/http://www.producersguild.org/pg/awards_a/awards2001win.asp |archivedate=February 15, 2003 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Snow|first1=Shauna|title=Arts And Entertainment Reports From The Times, News Services And The Nation's Press.|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2001-mar-06-ca-33797-story.html|access-date=September 23, 2017|work=Los Angeles Times|date=March 6, 2001|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121111061032/http://articles.latimes.com/2001/mar/06/entertainment/ca-33797|archive-date=November 11, 2012|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=PGA Award Winners 1990-2010 -
